title: Birth in 1899 and how he got the name Zilner
summary: Randolph gives his birth date and place and explains that a German repairman told his seamstress mother to name a baby boy Zilner.

story.theme_name: Stating your name and birth date on tape
story.community_name: Opening the tape: name, birth date and birthplace

blocks.x: -- Of course, now, you have -- you know the date because they have it. I was born on January 28th, 1899, in Durham, Arkansas. I think you have that.
Yes. And Zilner -- was that common name then, or is that a family name?

Yes. See, my mother was a seamstress. She was a professional seamstress and something happened to her machine and she had to send for this technician to come and fix it. And at the time he came she told me -- she was still pregnant with me -- so she said the German told her, he says, 'Now, that, if the baby be a boy, name him Zilner, and spell it z-i-l-n-e-r.' And so she wrote that down and so she named me Zilner.
I'll be darned. You were mentioning earlier that you and your brother were getting into music. About how old were you when you started playing guitar?
